lane: دَفَّةٌ : see دَفٌّ, in three places. === [Hence,] دَفَّتَا السَّرْجِ † [_The two side-boards of the horse's saddle;_] _the two boards that lie against the two sides of the beast;_ (Mgh;) or _the two sides_ [or _boards_] _of the horse's saddle, that embrace it between them:_ [see قَرَبُوسٌ:] and so دَفَّتَا الرَّحْلِ † _the two sides &c. of the camel's saddle._ (M.) And in like manner, (M,) دَفإَتَا المُصْحَفِ ‡ _The two sides_ [or _boards_] _of the book;_ (M, TA;) _the two things that embrace the book between them;_ (T, M, Mgh, K, * TA;) _the two faces, that are on the two sides, of the book._ (Msb.) One says, حَفِظَ مَا بَيْنَ الدَّفَّتَيْنِ ‡ [_He retained in his memory,_ or _got by heart, what is between the two boards,_ meaning _the whole contents,_ of the book]. (TA.) [دَفَّةٌ signifies also † _A board_ in a general sense; and so ↓دَفٌّ. And hence, † _A rudder._] And دَفَّةُ الطَّبْلِ † _The thing_ [or _piece of skin_] _that is upon the head of the drum:_ (so in a copy of the M:) or دَفَّتَا الطَّبْلِ ‡ _the two things,_ (T, K,) i. e. _the two pieces of skin,_ (TA,) _that are upon the head_ [or rather _upon the two extremities_] _of the_ [_common cylindrical_] _drum._ (T, K, TA.) One says, ضَرَبَ دَفَّتِى الطَّبْلِ ‡ [_He beat the two skins of the drum_]. (TA.)

entries.text: دفه: أهمله الليث وروى ثعلب عن ابن الأعرابي قال: الدافه: الغريب. قلت: كأنه قلب عن الداهف أو الهادف.
دفه: الأَزهري: أَهمله اللَّيْثُ، وَرَوَى ثَعْلَبٌ عَنِ ابْنِ الأَعرابي قَالَ: الدافِهُ الْغَرِيبُ؛ قَالَ الأَزهري: كأَنه بِمَعْنَى الدَّاهِفِ والْهادِفِ.
